Subject: Coordination: Compliance + DPA briefing — proposed 1‑hr slots

Hi Maya / FolioBank security team,

Thanks for the interest in a walkthrough. To make the session productive, we typically run a 45–60 minute briefing that covers: SOC 2 scope and evidence flow, DPA key clauses and handoff, and a short ops Q&A (pen-test logistics if relevant).

Quick ask: could you confirm which of these windows works best for your core stakeholders (security, legal, procurement)? I pasted options in PT/ET/UTC for convenience:
- Tue Oct 5: 9:00–10:00 PT / 12:00–13:00 ET / 17:00–18:00 UTC
- Wed Oct 6: 13:00–14:00 PT / 16:00–17:00 ET / 21:00–22:00 UTC
- Thu Oct 7: 07:30–08:30 PT / 10:30–11:30 ET / 15:30–16:30 UTC

If those don't map to your availability, flag two 45–60 minute windows and we’ll adapt. I’ve attached a short preflight checklist to help you route evidence/questions in advance (redwood-preflight-checklist.pdf).

Also: please let me know if you want the pen-test vendor included on the main call or prefer a separate ops handoff — we can carve out the last 15 minutes for procurement/contract questions.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0123
